parameters.prompt:
={{ 'You are a helpful standup assistant. Based on this activity data, write a daily standup report.

Format:
📋 Daily Standup — ' + $json.today + '

Yesterday:
• [completed items]

Today:
• [planned items based on open issues]

Blockers:
• [any blockers, or None]

Be concise and specific — reference issue numbers and commit SHAs when available.

' + $json.activityText }}

parameters.responseBody: ={ "status": "ok", "message": "✅ Standup posted to your personal DM or test channel.", "timestamp": "{{ $now.toISO() }}"}
